description: Synthetic, non-sensitive prevention and bounded fallback contracts required before release; these are not historical or live-host success certificates.

cases.observed_failure: Codex encrypted the relayed launch message before APE could attest it, allowing contract or receipt-schema omissions to reach a child.
cases.recovery_contract: The launch message and SubagentStart establish only provisional bootstrap identity. The child discovers the exact ape_bind name, binds with unchanged launch arguments, and acknowledges trusted post-bind hook-injected authority before stage work.
cases.test_anchor: codex-dispatch-envelope returns a static bootstrap and canonical hook context

cases.observed_failure: A material but correctable plan disagreement terminally blocked the run.
cases.recovery_contract: One scheduler-owned directed replan carries structured missing-assurance feedback before a repeated defect blocks.

cases.observed_failure: An implementer contradiction claim terminally blocked without independent adjudication.
cases.recovery_contract: One read-only reconciliation dispatch validates the claim and either resumes or blocks with structured evidence.

cases.observed_failure: Equivalent review findings with wording drift consumed distinct remediation cycles.
cases.recovery_contract: Canonical finding identity is derived from material evidence rather than prose wording.

cases.observed_failure: A capability or path denial did not state the exact safe recovery shape.
cases.recovery_contract: The refusal names additive claims and whether the current run can expand or requires a successor.

cases.observed_failure: A protected branch requiring auto-merge was treated as a terminal shipping failure.
cases.recovery_contract: Authorized shipping enables auto-merge and polls the exact pushed head to completion.
cases.test_anchor: enables GitHub auto-merge when branch policy rejects an immediate green merge

cases.observed_failure: Non-behavioral work was required to manufacture current-run red-test evidence.
cases.recovery_contract: Non-behavioral phase work omits preflight and test-writer stages.
cases.test_anchor: projects no test-writer stage for a non-behavioral full run

cases.observed_failure: Historical outcomes could not be attributed to an APE or dispatch-protocol version and collapsed to generic blocked status.
cases.recovery_contract: New terminal records retain runtime and protocol provenance plus a stable terminal reason code.

cases.observed_failure: An omitted audit reason produced a generic unsupported-undefined error before the actionable handler diagnostic.
cases.recovery_contract: The MCP schema declares conditional audit requirements and omitted optional fields reach the specific missing-reason diagnostic.
cases.test_anchor: preserves the answer-preflight reason diagnostic when reason is omitted over MCP

cases.observed_failure: A host-qualified catalog query returned no tool, and a child stopped for missing authority before making the binding call that supplies it.
cases.recovery_contract: Search the bare registered ape_bind name, call with exact launch arguments, and check trusted authority only after binding returns; offline composition does not certify real model compliance.
cases.test_anchor: composes the registered MCP bootstrap contract with source hooks, acknowledgement, and single-use start proof offline

cases.observed_failure: Expired launch windows and exact-token bootstrap rejections still appeared as ordinary waiting in parent diagnostics.
cases.recovery_contract: Report the effective launch deadline and bounded current-generation failure without replacing a live reservation or overwriting accepted proof.

cases.observed_failure: Candidate corruption could release an exact canary, while a merely observed unrelated child could be falsely quarantined on a new turn.
cases.recovery_contract: Immutable deny-only canary evidence survives candidate damage without classifying unrelated provisional children as canaries.

cases.observed_failure: Optional capability lists previously allowed unreachable future models, missing artifact producers, or schema limits to be discovered after dispatch.
cases.recovery_contract: One canonical pipeline compiles all reachable worker and runtime stages, consumer schemas, unchanged attempt limits, and a non-authoritative planner template before admission.

cases.observed_failure: Preview could omit repository or command facts and start could consume changed inputs without the reviewed commitment.
cases.recovery_contract: Read-only preview returns a complete bounded manifest and digest; public start checks exact reviewed inputs before branch, ticket, or worker mutation without treating the digest as human authorization.
cases.test_anchor: reviewed admission manifest through real lifecycle boundary

cases.observed_failure: A runner present on the preview checkout could disappear when start switched to its resolved base.
cases.recovery_contract: Read-only immutable Git comparisons reject changed exact command prerequisites before mutation and admit differing commits whose relevant prerequisites remain unchanged.
cases.test_anchor: command availability on the actual scheduled baseline

cases.observed_failure: A receipt rejection advised reset while the active lifecycle prohibited reset.
cases.recovery_contract: The bounded shared descriptor advertises only state-eligible actions with explicit operator preconditions; unexplained tree mutation never triggers automatic abort, reset, or restoration.

cases.observed_failure: Shipping could reach absent prerequisites, infer the wrong repository, or include staged content not covered by the passed gates.
cases.recovery_contract: Admission and explicit SHIP validate frozen target, identity, prerequisites, policy, and exact gate-tested tree; simulated effects reject drift and preserve staged content on refusal.

cases.observed_failure: Finding node or npm on PATH did not prove the configured entry script, package script, or shebang interpreter was available.
cases.recovery_contract: Bounded read-only inspection identifies unavailable static command prerequisites before dispatch, while allowing a present test command to fail legitimately and planned test files to be authored later.

cases.observed_failure: The projected review stage omitted targeted checks required by real fast and green-maintenance scheduler tickets.
cases.recovery_contract: Actual successful reducer transitions must fit exact canonical ticket schemas and whole branch-specific check variants, including preflight escalation; synthetic reducer events are not native-host or filesystem certification.
cases.test_anchor: prevention compiler against actual successful reducer transitions

cases.observed_failure: Malformed or unreviewed supersession inputs could create receipt-lock storage before admission and ancestor validation.
cases.recovery_contract: Run the same read-only schema, ancestor and admission checks before the outer lock and again inside it; rejected inputs do not create storage or follow redirected ancestors.

cases.observed_failure: A complete saved Codex tool result could be truncated in the next model request because escaped MCP framing exceeded the host budget despite an inner JSON bound and a larger execution-wrapper setting.
cases.recovery_contract: Compact repeated admitted metadata and bootstrap ticket bodies, preserve exact launch authority, measure escaped MCP framing, and refuse an undeliverable complete admission before mutation; do not retry the failed live campaign.
